title: Agent Room Bridge Message
description: Versioned messages exchanged over the authenticated Bridge WebSocket.

artifactMaterializationError.title: Artifact Materialization Error
artifactMaterializationError.description: Non-retryable negative acknowledgement when pinned Artifact content cannot be verified before Runtime admission.

message.pattern: ^Pinned Artifact content could not be verified in isolated staging\.$

supportsAgentProvisioning.description: Whether this connection can authorize and apply central Agent provisioning requests. Omission means unsupported.

roomContextBundle.title: Server Room Context Bundle
roomContextBundle.description: Server-owned coverage ending with one separate current request. Bridge derives session-local consumption from this bundle.

roomContextConsumption.title: Bridge Room Context Consumption
roomContextConsumption.description: Bridge-owned receipt for the exact checkpoint and raw interval accepted by one logical Runtime session.

artifactRelationRef.title: Artifact Relation Reference
artifactRelationRef.description: Immutable lineage from the containing source Artifact to older Task evidence.

artifactContentDescriptor.title: Pinned Artifact Content
artifactContentDescriptor.description: Immutable content metadata and a path-free logical alias pinned into one Run delivery.

artifactMaterializationReceipt.title: Verified Artifact Materialization Receipt
artifactMaterializationReceipt.description: Bridge-owned receipt for verified isolated staging; it never contains a local path.
